name: io.github.Servosity/blackpoint-mcp
title: Blackpoint Cyber CompassOne MCP
description: Blackpoint Cyber CompassOne: tenants, detections, assets, vulnerabilities and a cross-tenant view.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: CompassOne API token (Bearer). Create one in the CompassOne portal.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the CompassOne API. Leave the prefilled default unless Blackpoint gave your account a different host.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Blackpoint Cyber requests.

environmentVariables.name: BLACKPOINT_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
